title: Amazing Grace and Wondrous Love
identity: Hartley's Amazing Grace and Wondrous Love exists in more than one instrumentation: available catalog evidence describes soprano or alto saxophone with piano, and an alternate SSAATB saxophone ensemble version. The cataloged sax/piano item is Dorn DP1978.

Estate catalog lists the 2010 solo arrangement for soprano or alto saxophone and piano, 1:45, Dorn, separately from the SSAATB ensemble setting.
